newsitem.title: USA: Abercrombie started by Lazard as buy-sources.
newsitem.headline: Abercrombie started by Lazard as buy-sources.

text.p: Lazard Freres & Co started coverage of Abercrombie & Fitch Co with a buy rating, market sources said Monday.

Abercrombie began trading on the New York Stock Exchange last month in a deal underwritten by Lazard, Goldman Sachs & Co and J.P. Morgan & Co. Limited Inc bought Abercrombie from Oshman's Sporting Goods Inc in 1988 and still controls about 95 percent of the company's voting power.
Lazard's 12-month target price is $30, or 36 times its 1998 forecast of earnings of $0.82 a share, sources said.
Abercrombie's shares were unchanged at $26 in early afternoon trading.
